title: cirsium parryi subsp. viridiflorum
intro: Cirsium parryi subsp. viridiflorum, commonly known as Parry's thistle or Green-flowered Plume Thistle, is a plant species that belongs to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote digestive health and relieve various gastrointestinal issues, such as indigestion, bloating, and stomach discomfort. The therapeutic actions of Parry's thistle are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antacid properties, which help to soothe the digestive system and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Parry's thistle include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and other phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
